name: Applied Plastics

about:
Applied Plastics was founded in 1976 in Portland, Oregon, where it operates a 30,000-square-foot manufacturing facility. The company has remained at this location for nearly five decades, serving customers across the United States, Canada, and internationally.

The shop specializes in machining and fabricating plastic parts, offering services that include acrylic fabrication, laser cutting and engraving, and precision cutting of full sheets to size. It also extrudes its own UHMW board stock and reprocesses recycled UHMW into usable material. The facility handles sheets, rods, and tubes in a variety of plastics, though headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

Applied Plastics serves a range of markets, producing components for retail displays, industrial plastic applications, and extruded UHMW board stock. Its customer base spans multiple sectors that require custom plastic parts, from point-of-purchase fixtures to industrial wear components.

The company emphasizes a personal service guarantee, with machinists and fabricators working directly with clients on material selection and design. It also highlights environmental practices, including a near zero-waste operation that recycles acrylic scrap, extrudes recycled UHMW, and uses evaporative cooling and motion-activated lighting to reduce energy consumption.
